# Data Science: ETV & LFM

::: {.week-desc}
A hands-on course combining **Learn From Me (LFM)** video modules with **Extraction–Transformation–Visualization (ETV)** cycles. Each week pairs curated instructional videos with a real-data ETV activity.
:::

FRAMEWORKS

## How the course works
::: {.rule}
:::
:::

::: {.grid-cards}

::: {.card-x}
::: {.tag}
LFM
:::
### Learn From Me
Short video modules grouped by week. Watch, pause, and try the code examples before moving to the ETV activity.
:::

::: {.card-x}
::: {.tag}
ETV — Extract
:::
### E: Extraction
Pull real data from a source (CSV, Excel, API, or web). Understand where data lives and how to bring it into R.
:::

::: {.card-x}
::: {.tag}
ETV — Transform
:::
### T: Transformation
Clean, reshape, and summarize the data using `dplyr`. Every dataset needs work before it tells a story.
:::

::: {.card-x}
::: {.tag}
ETV — Visualize
:::
### V: Visualization
Build a plot with `ggplot2` that answers a real question. Visual output is the payoff of the entire cycle.
:::

:::
